builtin.description: True: a built-in preset. The apply tool refuses every candidate that changes or removes it, or that marks another preset this way; only the weekly model check (F2c) and a signed release (E1) update it.

based_on.description: The preset a custom preset was copied from, or null (started blank). `check` refuses an id that is no preset.

frontier_when.description: The class named needs_class goes first when the task's tier is listed here (routing.json task_tiers[]), or when no link of class_order meets the role's requirements.

last_resort.description: The class used only under a crossing grant (grants.json crossing_grants[]), or null: none.

verification_depth.description: How many Q1 reads the QA reviewer counts under this preset.

changelog.description: One line per update of a built-in preset (who, when, what), newest last.

active.description: False turns the role off under this preset; `check` refuses that for a role the workflow requires (routing.json workflow.required_roles) and for an exempt role (routing.json exempt_roles).

pins.description: Links tried first. `check` judges a pin of an active role as it judges an assignment's chain link (stella_data.link_problems): the connection switched on and allowing the role and its data classes, the model listed and meeting the role's requirements, the link inside the preset's allowed_localities unless its class is the last resort.

fallbacks.description: Links tried after the class candidates; checked like pins.

escalation_chain.description: The stronger rungs a card's builder climbs to (stored only; the walk is F2b).

roles.description: Per role of the role table (the key): what this preset changes for it.

additionalProperties.description: A routing preset (F2 D1.1): an effort mode is a preset. Every key but the first two is optional; a role the preset does not list follows the preset's own values and is active. `check` refuses a preset that leaves an active role no link that can serve it: none of its pins, its fallbacks and the catalog's links of its class order, needs class and last resort passes the link judge (the owner's global assignment for the role counts as one).

global_id.description: The record's global id: a lower-case version 4 UUID, unique across every data file (product rule 14). The record's old id stays its alias: every read that takes an entry id accepts either.

install_id.description: The UUID of the install that made the record (its .stella/install.json); a record moved from another install keeps it.

selection.description: Which preset is active: the card's beats the project's beats global (the default; ships standard).

connection.description: The link's connection: the id (alias) or global_id of a provider in the connections catalog. A link is a connection plus a model of it (F1b D6).

class.description: The id of a link class (routing.json link_classes[]).

class_or_null.description: A link class id or null. `check` refuses an id routing.json link_classes does not define.

class_order.description: Link classes in the order they are tried, at least one (an empty order would leave the role no link). An item is a class id, or a list of class ids: the best suited of these. `check` refuses an id routing.json link_classes does not define.

preset.description: The id of a preset (a key of effort_modes).
